---
title: "Exploration"
subtitle: "Interactive exploration of Golden Retriever health and longevity"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Use the controls below to choose what data you want to see. You can filter by overall health, activity level, gender, and weight range, and switch between the interactive chart and the data table.

```{r}
#| label: setup-crosstalk

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(DT)

dogs <- read_csv("golden_retrievers.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    activity_level = factor(activity_level, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    overall_health = factor(overall_health, levels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent"))
  )

shared_dogs <- dogs |> 
  slice_sample(n = 1500) |> 
  SharedData$new()
```

```{r}
#| label: filters

bscols(
  widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
  filter_select("health", "Overall Health:", shared_dogs, ~overall_health),
  filter_select("activity", "Activity Level:", shared_dogs, ~activity_level),
  filter_select("gender", "Gender:", shared_dogs, ~gender),
  filter_slider("weight", "Weight (lbs):", shared_dogs, ~weight_lbs, step = 1)
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Interactive Scatter Plot

```{r}
#| label: interactive-plot

plot_ly(
  shared_dogs,
  x = ~weight_lbs,
  y = ~lifespan_years,
  color = ~overall_health,
  colors = "Set2",
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(opacity = 0.65, size = 7),
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>Weight:</b> ", round(weight_lbs, 1), " lbs<br>",
    "<b>Lifespan:</b> ", round(lifespan_years, 1), " yrs<br>",
    "<b>Health:</b> ", overall_health, "<br>",
    "<b>Activity:</b> ", activity_level, "<br>",
    "<b>Gender:</b> ", gender
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Weight (lbs)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Life Expectancy (years)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Overall Health"))
  )
```

## Searchable Data Table

```{r}
#| label: interactive-table

datatable(
  shared_dogs,
  options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

:::
